title: Analytics — agregat instruktur per kelas
description: Instructor+ analytics for belajar-with-rahmanef.com (STATUS #17, deferred from #3 'agregat instructor+'): per-lesson completion counts, course-completion (badge) count, tenant member count, and quiz attempt/pass stats per course. READ-ONLY aggregates over shared tables — no new tables, no mutations, every number derived on read with documented bounded takes (no bare .collect(), P1). Outputs carry no user identifiers (no PII). No routes: the Kelola › Statistik tab mounts CourseAnalyticsView; useCourseSummaries feeds that tab's course list. 0.2.0: module grouping dropped (DECISIONS #37) — completions render as a FLAT per-materi list and ModuleQuizStat is now CourseQuizStat.

kelola › statistik tab (alpha #17): CourseAnalyticsView ← courseId dari daftar kelas di tab Statistik
useCourseSummaries(tenantId) ← angka {completionCount, memberCount} di daftar kelas kelola
